title: st blend (ending)
parentNote: Today is st on the END of a word — fast, mist, lost. It turns up at the front of words too, but that is a later day, so keep to endings for now. The s is a long hiss and the t is a tap, and the usual trouble is the tap going missing: "fast" comes out "fass" and "mist" comes out "miss". Stretch the hiss yourself and land the t hard — fassss-t — then say it at speed. This is also the first blend where the two sounds are easy to swap, so if you hear "fats" for "fast", point at the letters left to right with your finger while they say it.

activities.mouthCue: Hiss the s with your teeth almost shut, then tap your tongue down for the t.
activities.prompt: This pair is not like sh or ch. Here you really do hear both letters — they are just in a hurry.
